sloka: नष्टचित्तो यथोन्मत्तो विपरीतो यथातुरः ।हृततेजा यथा सर्पो बभूव जगतीपतिः ॥२-१२-५५॥
transliteration: naṣṭacitto yathonmatto viparīto yathāturaḥ ।hṛtatejā yathā sarpo babhūva jagatīpatiḥ ॥2-12-55॥

translations.english: The lord of the earth (Dasaratha) became like a man with the mind deranged, like a sick man behaving to the contrary, like a serpent with its energy drained (through mantra).
